description: Final cross-document consistency verification and defense readiness check. Verify all critical numerical values (SUS 61.83, N=30, demographics) are identical across presentation, manuscript, and script. Run comprehensive analysis again to confirm all issues resolved. Create final verification report documenting that all documents are consistent and ready for defense.
steps: 1. Open all three final documents side-by-side: SmartSpend_Defense.pptx, 1_MAIN_MANUSCRIPT_FINAL.docx, 4_DEFENSE_SCRIPT_FINAL.md
2. Create a verification matrix in a new file: analysis/FINAL_VERIFICATION_REPORT.md
3. Extract and compare SUS score from all three documents - should be exactly 61.83 in all places
4. Extract and compare sample size (N=30) from all three documents - should be consistent
5. Extract and compare demographics breakdown: '10 parents (ages 35-55)' and '20 young professionals (ages 21-35)' - wording may vary slightly but numbers must be exact
6. Extract and compare SUS grade/rating: 'Grade D' or 'OK' per Bangor et al. 2009 - should be consistent
7. Extract and compare survey period: 'Oct-Nov 2026' or 'October-November 2026' - should be 2026, not earlier
8. Extract and compare app version: 'v3.1.2' should appear in presentation and potentially in script/manuscript
9. Run comprehensive_analysis.py again - compare new results with original comprehensive_analysis.json to verify issues were fixed
10. Check presentation file: Use PowerPoint's 'Review' tab → 'Check Accessibility' and 'Inspect Document' to find any hidden issues
11. Check manuscript file: Use Word's Document Inspector (File → Info → Check for Issues → Inspect Document) to verify no tracked changes, comments, or hidden data remain
12. Test presentation on defense setup if possible: Check if slides display correctly, animations work, images are crisp, no formatting breaks
13. Verify all backup files exist: SmartSpend_Defense_BACKUP.pptx, 1_MAIN_MANUSCRIPT_FINAL_BACKUP.docx, 4_DEFENSE_SCRIPT_FINAL_BACKUP.md
14. Create FINAL_VERIFICATION_REPORT.md documenting: What was verified, What issues were found and fixed, Final consistency check results, Backup file locations, Defense readiness statement
15. Update analysis/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md with final completion status
acceptance_criteria: SUS score 61.83 appears identically in all three documents
Sample size N=30 appears in all three documents
Demographics (10 parents + 20 young professionals) match across all documents
Survey period stated as 2026 (not 2024 or 2025) in all documents
Re-running comprehensive_analysis.py shows 0 critical issues remaining (or only intentional cases documented)
All three backup files exist in analysis/ folder
FINAL_VERIFICATION_REPORT.md created with comprehensive verification results
PowerPoint Accessibility Checker shows no critical issues
Word Document Inspector shows no tracked changes or comments
verification: Compare new comprehensive_analysis.json with original - issues should be reduced significantly
Open FINAL_VERIFICATION_REPORT.md - verify it contains verification matrix with all critical values checked
Open SmartSpend_Defense.pptx → Review tab → Check Accessibility - review any warnings
Open 1_MAIN_MANUSCRIPT_FINAL.docx → File → Info → Check for Issues → Inspect Document - verify clean
Manually open all three documents and spot-check: 1) Title slide of presentation, 2) Abstract/Results section of manuscript, 3) Key slides in script
Verify IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md shows all phases complete
Present verification report to user confirming defense readiness
